strings.terrio was not found. Choose its locatio: terrio was not found. Choose its location in Settings, then press Reload.
strings.terrio could not start because a Windows: terrio could not start because a Windows component it needs is missing (usually VCRUNTIME140.dll). Install the Microsoft Visual C++ Redistributable (x64), then press Reload.
strings.terrio could not start: this terrio buil: terrio could not start: this terrio build does not match this PC (32/64-bit or ARM). Reinstall terrio, then press Reload.

strings.Choose an input folder and an output fol: Choose an input folder and an output folder at the top, pick a function tab, set its options and press Start. Every matching file in the input folder is processed and written to the output folder.
strings.Each tab's options are read from your ow: Each tab's options are read from your own terrio (terrio <command> --help), so every flag it has is here. Use Search options to find one by name or description, and Reload in Settings after upgrading terrio.
strings.On the Convert tab, choose the input typ: On the Convert tab, choose the input type (Image, Vector or Point cloud) to see only the options that apply to it. 'All options' shows everything. Options that are hidden are not added to the command.
strings.The menu at the top right opens a new ta: The menu at the top right opens a new tab, so you can start another job while the first one is still running. Each tab has its own folders, options, progress and log.
strings.terrio runs once per file. 'Parallel fil: terrio runs once per file. 'Parallel files' sets how many run at the same time; lower it for very large files.
strings.Copy command shows the exact command for: Copy command shows the exact command for one example file; Copy all commands scans the folder and copies one command per file.
strings.Each result is written under a temporary: Each result is written under a temporary name and renamed when terrio succeeds, so a failed or cancelled file never leaves a half-written output.
strings.Choose light or dark mode, the language,: Choose light or dark mode, the language, the order of the function tabs and where terrio is installed.
strings.In 'together' mode the files are added a: In 'together' mode the files are added as --input A, B, C…; remove the --input option, or use 'Each file separately'.
strings.Settings could not be read ({}). Startin: Settings could not be read ({}). Starting with defaults.
strings.Each file becomes input A. In 'together': Each file becomes input A. In 'together' mode the files become A, B, C… in name order, and the --input option is unavailable. Extra fixed inputs can be added under --input (B=path) when processing each file separately.
